ruleDefinitions.name: Potential DLL Injection Or Execution Using Tracker.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL injection and execution using "Tracker.exe"

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\tracker\\\.exe$") OR process_description = "Tracker") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/d\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/c\\ .*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/ERRORREPORT\\:PROMPT\\ .*") OR (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\Msbuild\\\\Current\\\\Bin\\\\MSBuild\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\Msbuild\\\\Current\\\\Bin\\\\amd64\\\\MSBuild\\\.exe$")))
